title: Ensure installed plugins are up to date
description: Most of a Jenkins controller's attack surface is its plugins, and most Jenkins security advisories are plugin advisories. This control carries no cisId on purpose: the CIS guide has no entry for keeping the CI system's own components current, and borrowing a neighbouring number would make the benchmark mapping dishonest. It is a supplement, listed after the mapped controls.
remediation: Manage Jenkins -> Plugins -> Updates: review and apply the pending updates, then restart if prompted. Check the changelog of anything pinned deliberately. The verdict is only issued when the controller's update-centre data is fresher than thresholds.updateSiteMaxAgeDays — on an air-gapped controller every plugin reports itself current because nothing has ever told it otherwise, and that is reported as MANUAL rather than as a pass.
fixSummary: Apply pending plugin updates at Manage Jenkins -> Plugins -> Updates.
